sourceCopy.name: Gin Rummy
sourceCopy.title: Gin Rummy Game Online Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Play Gin Rummy online against a local browser opponent. Form runs and sets, track deadwood, knock or go gin. Free, no account.
sourceCopy.intro: Play a quick local Gin Rummy hand against a simple computer opponent. Draw, discard and watch your best runs, sets and deadwood total update.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How do you play this Gin Rummy game?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Draw one card from the stock or discard pile, then discard one card. Build same-suit runs or equal-rank sets; knock with 10 or fewer deadwood points, or go gin with no deadwood.
sourceCopy.privacyQuestion: Does this Gin Rummy game upload my cards?
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. The deal and play run in this browser. There is no account, upload, server opponent or saved match.

additionalFaqs.question: Can I play Gin Rummy against the computer?
additionalFaqs.answer: Yes. One person plays locally against a lightweight browser opponent. It is not multiplayer.

additionalFaqs.question: What is deadwood in Gin Rummy?
additionalFaqs.answer: Cards not included in a run or set count as deadwood. Aces count as 1, number cards at face value, and face cards as 10.

additionalFaqs.question: Does this game support layoffs?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. Knock scoring uses the displayed no-layoff variant; house rules can differ.

fields.rulesNote: Draw one card, then discard one. Sets have the same rank; runs are consecutive ranks in the same suit.
fields.knockHint: You may declare knock after discarding with 10 or fewer deadwood points. This game uses a no-layoff scoring variant.
